content: We have a template result. It includes retro_smarts_template: '[C:2]-[OH;D1;+0:1]>>C-C(-C)(-C)-[Si](-C)(-C)-[O;H0;D2;+0:1]-[C:2]'. Wait that seems forward? Actually retro template is product to reactants? The retro_smarts_template shows product side (C:2)-[OH] -> reactants: t-BuSi etc. So applying this template to our target molecule (which contains TBS protected O) should give precursors: the protected group (t-butyldimethylsilyl) and the deprotected alcohol (the rest). The tool apply_template expects template_id. We have template_hash but not ID. The result includes reaction_id 29646. Likely template_id is that reaction_id? Or we can use the template via its hash? The tool get_template expects template_id. We could try get_template with reaction_id 29646. Let's try get_template with that ID.
